fact: Birr Metrics reports that Ethiopia adopted its National Artificial Intelligence Policy in 2024, setting priorities in AI research, human capital, digital infrastructure, innovation and responsible adoption.

UNDP's release says the Ethiopian AI Institute's director general stated Ethiopia had recently published its National Artificial Intelligence Policy; no date is given, so the document's published date of 2026-02-16 is used.

CIPESA says Ethiopia's AI policy designates the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute as national coordinating body for implementation, standards and capacity building, with the Ministry of Innovation and Technology providing policy oversight; the document gives no date for this, so its published date is used.
